cluster.headline: 1.6 מיליון חשבונות, 4.3 מיליארד שקל — כך הבנקים חוגגים על העמלות שלכם
cluster.body_note: Paywalled past lead paragraph (TheMarker .premium gate); no JSON-LD articleBody. Visible claims via WebFetch: ~1.6M independent trading accounts in Israel; NIS 4.3B in fee revenue from this segment in 2025; ~74% of that (~NIS 3.2B) stays with the banks; investment houses said to attract about half of new customers. Byline: Nati Tucker, published 25.10.2026 06:10. No regulator (Bank of Israel / Securities Authority / Capital Markets Authority) named as source in the visible text.
